richiami.difetto: For affected vehicles there is an issue involving the positive pole in the area of the passenger front fuse box for where a short circuit cannot be ruled out.

richiami.difetto: The attachments of the drive shafts to the gearbox and their support plates may not be properly tightened. This can prevent the correct transmission of drive to the wheels, leading to a loss of vehicle's control, creating a risk of accident and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 01/11/2024

traduzione.difetto: Le attrezzature di fissaggio degli assali motore alla cassa di trasmissione e le loro piastre di supporto potrebbero non essere state serrate correttamente. Ciò può impedire la trasmissione corretta della trazione alle ruote, causando la perdita di controllo del veicolo e creando un rischio di incidente e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: The software algorithm that calculates the percentage value of wear on the carbo-ceramic brake discs of the vehicle may not function properly due to a software bug which under certain specific conditions may cause a reset of the wear value estimated by the software. The risk is that the critical threshold of wear of the brake discs is reached without the relevant warning lamp and message being shown to the driver. If such a condition occurs the worst case scenario could be damage to the brake discs with increased risk of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Update of software for the instrument panel node.
richiami.titolo: DASH WARNING LIGHT MAY FAIL TO WARN DRIVER WHEN BRAKE DISCS ARE WORN AND CAUSE DAMAGE TO DISCS

richiami.difetto: It has been established that under exceptional and repeated high temperature conditions the clutch sensor may malfunction. Such a malfunction may inhibit the correct operation of the clutch preventing the selection of any gear or prevent engine ignition.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the clutch sensor replaced.
richiami.titolo: CLUTCH MAY MALFUNCTION PREVENTING THE SELECTION OF ANY GEAR

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the clutch master cylinder inlet union might fail causing a loss of clutch/brake fluid and possible gear selection problems.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the clutch master cylinder inlet union with one that conforms to specification.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE/CLUTCH FLUID MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is the possibility of a defect within the roll-over fuel shut off valves.  The affected component may fracture allowing fuel vapour to be released.
richiami.rimedio: To address the concern Ferrari will replace the affected valves with a modified type.
richiami.titolo: FUEL VAPOUR MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: The possibility exists that the forks which fasten the lower suspension levers to the chassis may have been fitted incorrectly thus creating increased stress in the threaded pin anchorage area. This could result in the possible breakage of the fork.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the suspension forks replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE BREAKAGE OF A FRONT SUSPENSION  FORK

richiami.difetto: A defect has been found within the roll-over fuel shut off valves located in the fuel tanks. This creates the possibility that the affected component may fracture allowing fuel  vapour to be released with the potential for a fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the roll-over valves replaced with a modified type.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT THE ROLL-OVER FUEL SHUT OFF FLOAT VALVES  MAY FRACTURE

richiami.difetto: Application of incorrect torque during production resulting in the possibility that the bolts may break.
richiami.rimedio: Recall likely to be affected vehicles and replace the wheel bolts
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE TORQUE PROBLEM  WITH THE WHEEL FIXING BOLTS

richiami.difetto: The hydraulic steering delivery pipe from the pump to the rack may be defective and in consequence may develop a slight leak. This in turn could lead to a gradual reduction in the steering assistance available.
richiami.rimedio: Likely to be affected vehicle swill be recalled at which time the subject pipe will be changed.
richiami.titolo: HYDRAULIC STEERING DELIVERY PIPE COULD CAUSE SLIGHT LEAK

richiami.difetto: The seat runners may not be correctly aligned and as a consequence the locks cannot engage simultaneously with both runners. This could result in unwanted movement of the seat when driving.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the seat runners.
richiami.titolo: SEAT RUNNER LOCKS MAY NOT ENGAGE SIMULTANEOUSLY.

richiami.difetto: The gearbox oil radiator return and delivery pipes may leak due to an error in the manufacturing process. This could impair the operation and reliability of the gearbox.
richiami.rimedio: Fit quality assured oil radiator return and delivery pipes.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LEAK FROM GEARBOX OIL RADIATOR PIPES.

richiami.rimedio: Fit quality assured oil radiator return and delivery pipes.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LEAK FROM GEARBOX OIL RADIATOR PIPES.

richiami.rimedio: Fit quality assured oil radiator return and delivery pipes.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LEAK FROM GEARBOX OIL RADIATOR PIPES.

richiami.difetto: The gaiter and associated parts connecting the fuel filler neck to the  tank may not conform to specification. This may cause a fuel leak which could contaminate the tyres and adversely affect the handling of the car.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the fuel filler neck connecting system with parts that comply with the specification.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: The gaiter and associated parts connecting the fuel filler neck to the  tank may not conform to specification. This may cause a fuel leak which could contaminate the tyres and adversely affect the handling of the car.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the fuel filler neck connecting system with parts that comply with the specification.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the bolt locating inserts fitted to the magnesium wheel rims may crack if excessive torque is applied to the retaining bolts. This may result in the possible loosening of the affected bolts.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the original wheel rims with aluminium ones that do not have inserts. Also fit new wheel bolts.
richiami.titolo: ROADWHEELS MAY BECOME LOOSE

richiami.difetto: Incorrect tightening of the engine oil filter coupled with a less compliant O ring design could result in a serious oil leak and subsequent fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new type oil filter - Part No. 191993
richiami.titolo: ENGINE OIL FILTER MAY LEAK

richiami.difetto: The anti-lock braking system electronic control under certain heavy braking conditions may fail resulting in the braking action being biased to the rear wheels which may cause instability.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace software in anti-lock braking system electronic control unit.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT VEHICE MAY BECOME UNSTABLE WHEN BRAKING UNDER EXTREME CONDITIONS

richiami.difetto: The screws retaining the Air Bag ECU may be of insufficient length to ensure long term reliability.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the fixing screws with ones of longer length.
richiami.titolo: THE AIR BAG ELECTRICAL CONTROL UNIT FIXATION SCREWS MAY BE OF INSUFFICIENT LENGTH

richiami.difetto: The lower front suspension arm mounting forks could deform after a substantial impact (for example after an accident) and should this condition remain unnoticed the eventual result could be the failure of the forks resulting in the collapse of the front suspension.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit an uprated stronger mounting fork.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT IMPACT DISTORTION TO FRONT SUSPENSION COULD RESULT IN SUBSEQUENT FAILURE

richiami.difetto: The lower front suspension arm mounting forks could deform after a substantial impact (for example after an accident) and should this condition remain unnoticed the eventual result could be the failure of the forks resulting in the collapse of the front suspension.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit an uprated stronger mounting fork.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT IMPACT DISTORTION TO FRONT SUSPENSION COULD RESULT IN SUBSEQUENT FAILURE

richiami.difetto: The pivot pin that connects the throttle pedal to the operating linkage may break due to incorrect heat treatment of the pin. This may cause a loss of throttle control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the parts concerned with quality assured units.
richiami.titolo: THROTTLE PEDAL LINKAGE MAY BREAK

richiami.difetto: Due to insufficient clamping pressure of fuel pipe ferrule attaching the flexible hose to the pipe end fitting it is possible that a fuel leak may occur in the engine compartment.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles remove the suspect fuel hoses and fit quality assured replacements.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK IN ENGINE COMPARTMENT

richiami.difetto: Due to possible incorrect alignment of the splines it is possible that the steering column shaft clamp bolt may be insufficiently tightened.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and examine column shaft for correct alignment of the splines. Check that column clamp bolt has been tightened to the specified torque.
richiami.titolo: STEERING COLUMN SHAFT CLAMP BOLT MAY HAVE BEEN INSUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED

richiami.difetto: Possible damage to fuel tank caused during production installation of Spider roof mechanism. A fixing screw of the roof mechanism trim cover may make contact with the fuel tank and cause possible leakage.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for examination and replacement of fuel tank if found necessary.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO FUEL TANK DURING VEHICLE ASSEMBLY COULD RESULT IN A FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: The fuel line retaining nuts may split after tightening if the recommended torque has been exceeded. This can cause leakage of fuel with an attendant risk of fire. This campaign augments recall R1997/55 but applies only to cars built after the launch of that campaign.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled for replacement of the fuel lines.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAKAGE

richiami.difetto: An incorrectly positioned water hose retaining clamp may chafe on a fuel hose. This can damage the hose and result in leakage of fuel.
richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled to have the hose clamp repositioned with the clamp screw clear of the fuel hose.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FUEL LEAK

richiami.difetto: The seat belt mountings may detach from the rear bulkhead in an accident situation.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles are being recalled for the fitment of reinforcing plates at the belt mounting points on the rear bulkhead.
richiami.titolo: SECURITY OF SEAT BELT MOUNTINGS

richiami.difetto: The bolts securing the components of the multi piece wheel rim may loosen slightly. This can result in loss of tyre pressure.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the wheel rims with quality assured examples secured by bolts treated with locking compound.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LOSS OF TYRE PRESSURE

richiami.difetto: The aluminium ferrules clamping the flexible fuel pipes on the pressure side of the injection system to their unions may deteriorate due to atmospheric conditions. In extreme cases this could allow fuel leakage with the possibility of an engine bay fire.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the original flexible fuel pipes with modified versions.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE LEAKAGE FROM FLEXIBLE FUEL PIPING
